moments.why: One consideration beat acknowledges the question before the answer. Avoid a face change at every noun.
A brief pleased acknowledgement follows the synthetic user's understanding. Compare the return to attentive at 8900 or 9300 ms.
A wry look responds to the failed model stand without holding a taunting face over the whole reply. Compare its return at 1500 or 1900 ms.
The user cuts in. Close speech immediately, cancel pending returns, and make quiet-listening the new intent within the native 400 ms transition.
Concern remains through the deliberate wait. Waiting is activity; it does not imply a new emotional preset.
The synthetic user reports progress. Change from concerned to reassuring before the recorded acknowledgement begins.
The delivery gap rests the mouth and freezes audible position at 1100 ms, while reassuring remains the emotional intent.
After the answer resumes and ends, a small pleased reaction acknowledges recovery. Compare the return to reassuring at 8200 or 8600 ms.

adversarialChecks.name: new-intent-during-reaction
adversarialChecks.steps: At second-attempt 1200 ms inject concerned as current intent. After the old reaction deadline, concerned must remain; quiet-listening must not be restored by a captured old value.

adversarialChecks.name: interrupt-before-audio
adversarialChecks.steps: Manually interrupt hinge at 1000 ms. Its scheduled 2000 ms audio start must stay canceled.

adversarialChecks.name: interrupt-in-gap
adversarialChecks.steps: Manually interrupt patience at 5500 ms. The scheduled 6000 ms resume and 7800 ms reaction must stay canceled.

adversarialChecks.name: pause-in-gap
adversarialChecks.steps: Pause patience at 5500 ms for arbitrary wall time. On resume, 500 ms of scene gap remains and audible position is still 1100 ms.

adversarialChecks.name: replay-before-reaction-return
adversarialChecks.steps: Replay second-attempt at 1300 ms. Old reaction expiry cannot change the new scene epoch.
